evals.name: mindgard-ai-security-seed
evals.prompt: I want to run an IC sim. Deal: Mindgard. AI security — red-teaming for LLMs and agents. Seed stage, ~8 FTE, UK. Lead competitor is HiddenLayer. Working with 3 FTSE 100 customers in pilot, 1 paid. Play both me (a reasonably-prepared associate giving specific, numerate answers) and the committee. Run 5 full committee turns (so ~10 back-and-forths), then produce the final report. Write the complete transcript and final report as markdown to outputs/session.md.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file containing: (1) a deal brief, (2) ~10 alternating turns with the 4 committee members named, sentiment tags visible, (3) a final report with 5 scores /10, a summary, 3 improvement notes, and a sentiment trajectory. Committee members must stay in-character and ask exactly one question each turn.

evals.name: alinia-ai-compliance-preseed
evals.prompt: Practice IC for Alinia — AI compliance platform for EU AI Act Article 6 high-risk systems. Pre-seed, €2M round, founder ex-McKinsey digital. Initial target: BaFin-regulated tier-2 German banks. No paid customers yet, 2 LOIs. Simulate both the presenter (moderately-prepared, some fuzzy answers on unit economics) and the committee. 5 committee turns. Write the full transcript + scored report to outputs/session.md.
evals.expected_output: Same structure as eval 0. The Regulatory Hawk should be especially active given the deal. The scoring should reflect that unit economics answers were weak (Operator score lower).

evals.name: suena-energy-series-a
evals.prompt: Run ic-sim for Suena Energy. Series A pre-empt. $12M round. Energy trading AI for European gas/power wholesale markets. Ex-Vattenfall and ex-Trayport founding team of 3. ARR $2.4M, 4 paying tier-1 utility customers, 60% gross margin. Lead competitor is Montel. Simulate a strong presenter who gives specific numbers and names risks up front. 5 turns. Output transcript + report as markdown to outputs/session.md.
evals.expected_output: Same structure. A strong presenter should score higher (7+) on conviction, data density, risk ack. The Portfolio Lens should ask about fund overlap and reserve strategy given it's a Series A pre-empt.
